escalation_policy.content: PR Escalation Policy v3.1 (effective 2026-04-01): TIER 1 (immediate PR escalation) = Negative sentiment AND verified account AND followers >= 100000 AND reach >= 50000. TIER 2 (monitor 24h) = Negative + verified + followers 25000-99999. TIER 3 (no action) = unverified accounts or followers < 25000 or non-negative sentiment. Influencer override: any verified account > 1M followers is Tier 1 regardless of reach. All Tier 1 items require a human-reviewed escalation brief before the PR team is engaged. Do not contact the PR team outside business hours (09:00-18:00 ET) unless flagged crisis-level by a manager.
